name: cavemio-text-morph
title: Text Morph
description: Animate changing text with shared letters that move into place, soft arrivals, and a smoothly resizing width.

cavemio.accessibility: The readable text stays available to assistive technology while decorative glyphs are hidden. Reduced motion swaps the label in place and clears outgoing glyphs. Use animateWidth={false} for wrapping text.
cavemio.previewNote: Demo values are local; no network requests.

useCases.title: Button labels
useCases.description: Move between Save, Saving and Saved in the same button.

useCases.title: Hero headlines
useCases.description: Change one word while keeping the rest of a sentence anchored.

useCases.title: Status labels
useCases.description: Let a badge explain a change without a sudden text swap.

useCases.title: Plan names
useCases.description: Update a selected plan or billing label in place.

features.title: Shared letters keep their place
features.description: Matching characters stay mounted and move to their next position.

features.title: A soft entrance and exit
features.description: New letters arrive with a short stagger; outgoing characters lift and fade.

features.title: The width follows the words
features.description: The surrounding inline box resizes as the label changes.

features.title: Readable without motion
features.description: A real text layer remains available, with a static reduced-motion presentation.

states.title: Shared letters
states.description: Matching glyphs move between their previous and new positions.

states.title: New and leaving letters
states.description: New characters enter; removed characters blur and fade away.

states.title: Unrelated labels
states.description: Labels with little overlap transition as whole groups.

states.title: Reduced motion
states.description: Text updates immediately without spatial animation.

props.name: children
props.description: The current label. Change it to start a morph.

props.name: direction
props.description: The direction new characters enter from. Defaults to up.

props.name: animateWidth
props.description: Animate the inline width; disable for multi-line text.
